verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer documents reading and sending email via Gmail and Outlook, scheduling calendar events, and a managed connector framework covering 400+ services with one-click OAuth. It also connects to Google Sheets and Notion. A cloud drive (e.g., Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive) is never named. Calendar support is described as scheduling events, not searching them for answers. missing for 10: explicit cloud-drive connector documentation, evidence of searching calendar data to ground answers, independent or hands-on corroboration of connector use.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers

citations.quote: Read and send emails via Gmail and Outlook, and schedule calendar events
Connect to 400+ services through a managed connector framework with one-click OAuth
Analyze data from Snowflake, Databricks, Google Sheets, Salesforce, and other sources
If Computer needs to connect to a service mid-task, it returns an `auth_required` event, and after authentication the conversation resumes on the same thread
